# table-alignment

- ID: `MDL003`
- Category: Tables
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `table`

Each cell of a table's delimiter row has at least 3 dashes.

## Why

GFM accepts a single dash, but 3 dashes make the row under the header easy to
see in the source.

## Options

Set them under `rules.table-alignment.options`.

- `min_dashes` (`integer`, default `3`): Fewest dashes allowed in a cell of a
  table's delimiter row.

## Fix

The fix lengthens each short run of dashes to the minimum and keeps any colons.
gomdlint may report a finding without a fix when the fix would change a line
with one character in brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it
up to a blank line, because it could add or remove a task list checkbox.

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  table-alignment:
    options:
      min_dashes: 3
```

Under `rules`, `table-alignment: false` turns the rule off and
`table-alignment: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable table-alignment` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line table-alignment -->
```

## markdownlint

markdownlint does not have this rule.
